s1_lead: Tab opens it. Everything you carry and everything around you.
s1_points: Your 3D character with every worn item, both hands, the back slot.
Pockets and every bag you wear, each one a grid.
Floor, furniture, cars, corpses: pick one, its grid opens.
The hotbar along the bottom, ready to fill.
s2_lead: A Tarkov-style grid for every pocket, bag and shelf.
s2_points: A rifle is long, a can is small. Pack your bags like a puzzle; R turns an item while you drag it.
Ammo and nails share a tile. Alt + click splits a stack, dropping one onto another merges them.
Ctrl + click or draw a frame to select; Shift + click sends everything to the other side.
One click empties a container into your bags, or packs a grid neatly.
s3_lead: Equipment around a 3D character that moves with you.
s3_points: Head, face, chest, armor, arms, backpack, rig, belt, legs, feet - each holds its layers: the mouse wheel or the arrows go through them.
Hover an empty slot: you see what fits from your bags and put it on in one click. Works on the game's hotbar too.
Hover an item or a menu option: its slot lights up; what it would replace turns red.
With the Java part your character repeats your moves and holds what you hold.
s3_bottom: Drop clothes on the model or in the free space under your bags to put them on. Drag a bag's header to take it off.
s4_points: Double click a bag: its grid opens in a window, tied to its tile by a thread. Drop items on a bag to put them inside.
Turn, roll and zoom any item, with its stats and description.
As in the game: an item waits in place, filling up, and appears where it goes at the end. Several moves are numbered.
Item tooltips, context menus, the hotbar and the cursor. Read books and watched tapes are marked.
s5_lead: Knox Inventory redesigns the whole Project Zomboid UI in one style, one stage at a time.
s5_sub: Each stage is tested in public before the next one begins. Until a stage lands, its tab opens the game's own window.
s5_stages: Equipment, grids, bags, surroundings, quick slots, tooltips, context menus, hotbar, cursor.
Your injuries on your character's body, treatment in a click or by dropping an item on a wound.
Skills and progress, and the world map, in the Knox style.
Crafting, building, vehicles, menus - the rest of the game's windows, one by one.
s5_bottom: Feedback decides what comes first: tell us in the comments what you want to see in Knox style.
m1_lead: The main menu is a camp at night, fully 3D.
m1_points: The three latest survivors of your saves sit by the fire, looking exactly as you left them.
Those who died walk behind the fence as zombies. Older ones lie under the crosses.
The mod's updates as cards. A click opens the post.
The items fade away after a few seconds and return with the mouse.
m2_lead: Point at a hero to see who they are. Click to play.
m2_points: Portrait, name, profession, game mode and the town they stopped in.
Days survived, zombies killed, health - and their state in words: thirsty, injured, bitten...
The hero gets up and walks off into the dark, the screen fades and the save loads. No lists, no dialogs.
Exit to the menu: your hero walks out of the dark and sits down by the fire again.
m2_bottom: A hero's look is remembered while you play: face, hair, every piece of clothing, the weapon in their hands.
m3_lead: The dead never come back to the fire.
m3_points: The last three who died wander behind the fence - in the clothes they died in.
Those before them have crosses by the fence, a grave lantern burning next to them.
Point at one to see who it was and how long they lasted.
m3_bottom: A click on a fallen hero starts over in the same world.
m4_points: What is new, what changed and what was fixed - with pictures, right in the game.
Unread posts are marked. A click opens the post over the whole screen.
Scroll with the wheel, close with Esc.

n_shots.name: newgame
n_shots.title: A NEW GAME, STEP BY STEP
n_shots.lead: The whole way to a new game in Knox style.
points: Mode, spawn, world, character - one after another, each in the same look.
A list on the left, the mode's video and what it is on the right.
These are the game's own screens redrawn: what mods add stays.
n_shots.bottom: Click the tent in the camp to start a new survivor.

n_shots.name: spawn
n_shots.title: WHERE IT BEGINS
n_shots.lead: Towns, the world map and the town's file on one screen.
points: Drag it, zoom it; it moves to the town you pick.
Its description and video, the save's name and the world's seed.
Their towns are in the list as before.

n_shots.name: sandbox
n_shots.title: SANDBOX OPTIONS
n_shots.lead: Every setting is a row. Help is always on the right.
points: The pages are split in two, mods' pages show up by themselves.
Changed settings are marked in sand - the name and the value.
What the setting under the mouse does and its default.
n_shots.bottom: Presets are saved and loaded as in the game.

n_shots.name: survivor
n_shots.title: ONE SCREEN FOR YOUR SURVIVOR
n_shots.lead: The game's two character screens are now one.
points: Name, occupation, points, chosen traits and skills on the left.
One list with filters. Excluded ones stay, dimmed, with the reason.
Their occupations, traits and clothes work as before.
n_shots.bottom: A click takes a trait or gives it back.

n_shots.name: loading
n_shots.title: THIS IS HOW YOU DIED
n_shots.lead: The loading screen: the same words, a new look.
points: In the middle, in Knox's font.
On a plate at the bottom.
Instead of the walking figure. Full means you can start.
n_shots.bottom: Dialogs, color pickers and the menu's corner buttons are in Knox style too.
